notes: Next.js App Router, production build, served through its custom-server API in one process. /about is prerendered at build time; pages are gzipped by default.
details: App Router with Server Components, built with `next build` and served by Next's production server through the documented custom-server API (next({ dev: false }) and its request handler on node:http) inside the measured process. Next's defaults, compression and caching included; only the project root is set (to the work folder) and telemetry is off.
